title: Mockery
html_source:
Mulligan is later identified with Photius again in the Scylla and Charybdis episode (McCourt. J The Bloom Years, p61).

Photius caused very significant divisions and ultimately a monumental schism in the church through politicking. The association of Buck Mulligan with Photius is fits neatly into the pen picture Joyce paints of him(1) in Telemachus – a necessary vile description in order to set up the rationale of Stephen’s decision to leave the tower and not return

(1)Strandentwining Cable': Joyce, Flaubert, and Intertextuality
By Scarlett Baron.
